title: Hopper Stats
description: A lightweight server-compatible hopper tracking mod. Hold a keybind and right-click any hopper to start counting items -- see total throughput, items per hour, and a per-item breakdown, all displayed as a floating text label on the hopper face.
body:
Hopper Stats adds a simple, clean overlay that displays real-time statistics for hoppers in your world -- including items per second, total items transferred, and whether the hopper is active or blocked.

## How to Use

**Hold Keybind + Click** - Hold set Keybind & click a hopper to activate its counter

**Toggle Item Details** - Look at a hopper and press the keybind to show/hide per-item breakdown

## Features
- Real-time items per second display
- Total items transferred counter
- Active / blocked status at a glance
- Per-item detail breakdown
- Works on singleplayer and multiplayer servers
